working: Hampir semua yang mahu bekerja mempunyai pekerjaan: pengangguran hanya 1.8% (2024), lebih rendah daripada Kedah (2.5%).
holding: Pendapatan penengah isi rumah RM3,367 sebulan (2024) — 31% lebih rendah daripada Kedah — dan lebih rendah berbanding 2019 (RM3,583).

watch: Unjuran KDNK 2030: RM2.1 bilion (julat RM1.9–2.4 bilion), iaitu 3.2% setahun.

working: Almost everyone who wants a job has one: unemployment is only 1.8% (2024), below Kedah's 2.5%.
holding: Median household income is RM3,367 a month (2024) — 31% below Kedah — and lower than in 2019 (RM3,583).

watch: Projected GDP in 2030: RM2.1 billion (range RM1.9–2.4 billion), or 3.2% a year.
